sar.narrative: On November 22, 2016, at 16:11:00, an online transaction of $74.96 was executed on card C13487-K1 associated with customer C13487. The transaction utilized a new device profile running Android 7.0 via an anonymous IP proxy and was flagged due to shared fraudulent infrastructure. During investigation, the cardholder denied the activity and failed to complete the one-time passcode challenge. Similar fraudulent patterns are documented in historical cases such as CC-0590, CC-5122, and CC-1075, involving unauthorized card-not-present transactions from new mobile devices. The fraud involves coordinated exploitation of multiple cards through a shared device profile and anonymous proxy network. Consequently, a fraud report is required under policy R6 for shared origin activity.
